parts.t: ORIGINAL OWNERS, 36 YEARS OF PRIDE! Beautifully maintained 4-bed, 3-bath rancher with loft tucked into a quiet cul-de-sac in Ladner's Holly neighborhood. At 2,519 sqft, this home is ideal for downsizers or families, with a spacious main-floor primary bedroom, generous living and dining rooms, and a bright kitchen with adjoining eating area and family room. Vaulted ceilings and skylights fill it with light, two fireplaces bring warmth, and updated tilt-and-turn windows keep it comfortable year-round. Upstairs, the loft/bedroom has its own full bathroom—ideal for family or guests—plus excellent storage. Fenced backyard with patio, garden shed, and double garage. Close to Holly Elementary, parks, and Ladner Village. A lovingly cared-for home ready for its next chapter! OPEN HOUSE Sat/Sun 1-3

v: The primary bedroom is on the main floor, with a walk-in closet and ensuite.
The upstairs loft or bedroom has its own full bathroom plus a large storage room.
Vaulted ceilings, skylights and two fireplaces, with updated tilt-and-turn windows.
A 7,137 sq ft RS5-zoned lot on a quiet cul-de-sac in Ladner's Holly neighbourhood; buyers should confirm permitted uses with the City of Delta.
The fenced backyard has a patio and a garden shed.
Double garage with parking for 6 vehicles in total.
